title: SDR slides written unscaled to an scRGB (Rgba16Float, 1.0 = 80 nits) HDR swapchain
expected_finding: fs_main writes decoded SDR sRGB slide values (reference white 1.0) unchanged into the R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT / EXTENDED_SRGB_LINEAR swapchain, where 1.0 means 80 nits; SDR white should map to ~203/80 = 2.54, so SDR slides show at ~40% brightness
